alright, one thing I want to do is make roost feel better, I think we can add some nice animations to things, make things feel faster and smoother to use, etc... right now, there's still some jank and not nice animations. I want this to feel very smooth. 

An example of something I want to feel smooth is, the message box animating from the bottom up to where it should be when a message from the user gets sent. those type of nice UX patterns is what I want more of for this app. Please find and implement some of these
I'll start by exploring the frontend to understand the current structure, animation setup, and where the jank is.

Both dev servers are stopped (exit 143 is just the kill signal). Nothing is committed; the changes are in your working tree.

## What I changed

**A motion system, then the UX patterns on top of it.**

- **Shared motion tokens** in `src/styles/motion.stylex.ts`: three durations and three easings. The durations collapse to 0ms under `prefers-reduced-motion`, so every animation respects that setting automatically.
- **Entrance gating** in `src/features/motion.ts`. Three hooks make sure animations only play for changes the user caused, never as a replay of server-rendered markup at startup.

**The send animation you asked for.** When you send, your bubble rises 18px from the composer with a fade and a 0.97→1 scale, while the history smooth-scrolls to make room. Agent replies and tool rows fade up when they arrive. Streaming updates still jump instantly so auto-scroll never fights you while reading. A guard ignores the scroll events a smooth scroll emits, so following the reply is not disabled by our own scroll.

**Popups never animated open before.** Base UI skips the entrance transition for a dialog that mounts already open, which is exactly how every Roost dialog mounted (lazy-loaded on first open). A one-tick deferred open fixes the settings sheet, mobile drawer, and Inspector. The Inspector now also animates out before unmounting.

**Other smoothing:**
- Sidebar collapse animates its width shut instead of unmounting, with `inert` keeping hidden links out of the tab order.
- Tool activity panels animate height on open/close, and the chevron rotates instead of swapping icons.
- Buttons get a hover wash, press scale, and color transitions. The send button dims at 35% when empty and lights up as you type. The composer gets a soft accent focus ring.
- Send/stop icon pops when swapping, the "Replying…" dot breathes, attachments and approval cards slide in, sidebar and home rows have hover transitions.

**Your follow-up:** the sidebar splitter is now `src/components/ui/resize-handle.tsx`, a reusable `ResizeHandle` with pointer and keyboard handling, taking `value`, `min`, `max`, `step`, and `onResize`.

## Verification

Chrome extension was not connected, so I ran headless Chromium against a dev server on a scratch database. Your real database was untouched. Frame-by-frame recordings confirmed the bubble rise, the sheet and drawer slides, the sidebar width transition, the panel collapse, reduced-motion zeroing, and no startup replay. Lint, typecheck, 72 tests, and the production build all pass. The motion guidance is documented in `docs/development.md`.

One caveat: I could not exercise the send/stop button swap or the typing indicator with a live agent run. They use the same verified gating hook.
